<a id="comm-loss"></a>
## Comm-loss warning: display only, only after the first recovery, rule differs from the Commander's

The mission server's rule is `~(state == 2 && error >= 0)` after `time > 1`; the Commander's is `state ~= 2 && error < 0` after `time > 3`, held 0.1 s (Threshold1), plus a data-loss check on the echoed timestamp held 0.5 s (Threshold2). In the mission server the comm-issue flag (inport SID 4281) feeds a Product (SID 4457) and the trigger of a Triggered Subsystem (SID 4466) whose trigger is `falling`: its output, the Product's second input, only changes once the flag has fallen, i.e. after the first recovery. The Product goes only to a Display (SID 4298) and a Show Message on Host block (SID 4459); nothing reaches the command path.

[`docs/spec/Mission_Server_QDrone_YOLO_Autonomous_Land/charts/chart_56_MATLAB_Function.m` L1–L9](../../docs/spec/Mission_Server_QDrone_YOLO_Autonomous_Land/charts/chart_56_MATLAB_Function.m#L1-L9)

```text
     1  function stream_connection_loss  = fcn(time, state, error)
     2  
     3  stream_connection_loss = 0;
     4  if time > 1
     5      if ~((state == 2)&&(error >= 0))
     6          % stream connection is not established correctly
     7          stream_connection_loss = 1;
     8      end
     9  end
```

<a id="data-out"></a>
## "Data Out [14]" passes elements 1-13

In the Commander's Communication subsystem, "Select the rest of the data" takes `[1:13]` of the 14-wide stream and element 14 goes to its own selector for the loopback echo; the outport is named "Data Out [14]".

<a id="last-frame"></a>
## `lastFrame` is kept across takeoff cycles

`lastFrame` is persistent and initialised once; the `~takeoff` branch resets `good`, `bad`, `active` and `lastFresh`, not `lastFrame`.

[`docs/spec/Mission_Server_QDrone_YOLO_Autonomous_Land/charts/chart_65_YOLO_Confirmation_and_Hover_Hold.m` L3–L8](../../docs/spec/Mission_Server_QDrone_YOLO_Autonomous_Land/charts/chart_65_YOLO_Confirmation_and_Hover_Hold.m#L3-L8)

```text
     3  persistent good bad active captured lastFrame lastFresh latestU latestV
     4  if isempty(good), good=uint8(0); bad=uint8(0); active=false; captured=zeros(4,1); lastFrame=-1; lastFresh=-1; latestU=0; latestV=0; end
     5  takeoff=triggers(2)>0.5; newPadSample=false;
     6  if ~takeoff, good=uint8(0); bad=uint8(0); active=false; lastFresh=clockTime; end
     7  if takeoff && newVision && vision(5)~=lastFrame
     8   lastFrame=vision(5); lastFresh=clockTime; valid=vision(1)>0.5 && vision(4)>=0.600000 && vision(2)>=0 && vision(2)<=640 && vision(3)>=0 && vision(3)<=480;
```


<a id="vision6"></a>
## The mission server ignores the publisher's timestamp `vision(6)`

The YOLO confirmation chart reads `vision(1)` to `vision(5)` only; no chart of the mission server reads `vision(6)` (count below).

[`docs/spec/Mission_Server_QDrone_YOLO_Autonomous_Land/charts/chart_65_YOLO_Confirmation_and_Hover_Hold.m` L7–L8](../../docs/spec/Mission_Server_QDrone_YOLO_Autonomous_Land/charts/chart_65_YOLO_Confirmation_and_Hover_Hold.m#L7-L8)

```text
     7  if takeoff && newVision && vision(5)~=lastFrame
     8   lastFrame=vision(5); lastFresh=clockTime; valid=vision(1)>0.5 && vision(4)>=0.600000 && vision(2)>=0 && vision(2)<=640 && vision(3)>=0 && vision(3)<=480;
```
